race.comment: SCARLET HAZE (7) gets the nod despite a plain seventh at Sunshine Coast, with the key being her sharper Emerald fourth two starts back when beaten just under a length in a BM50. She is race-fit, reaches the third run of the campaign and looks better placed in this grade if the quick turnaround has not dulled her. BRAIDWOOD QUEEN (14) has the most recent winning form, having beaten DAINTREE DREAMING by three lengths at this track, and her record at both this venue and the distance keeps her right in the race. DAINTREE DREAMING (13) has to turn that result around, but his track record is sound and his season form is respectable enough to give him a genuine chance. KOBE ASCOT (5) was third first-up at Taroom and brings a consistent place profile, though his record around 850m keeps him more in the each-way mix.
